question: share of money raised from repeat givers versus one-time givers, in percent, plus a count of repeat givers
gold_sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS gifts, SUM("Amount") AS donor_total FROM donations GROUP BY "Donor") SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN donor_total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(donor_total) AS repeat_share_percent, SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_donor_count FROM counts

WITH donor_counts AS (
  SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS donation_count
  FROM "donations"
  GROUP BY "Donor"
),
donor_categories AS (
  SELECT 
    "Donor",
    CASE 
      WHEN donation_count > 1 THEN 'Repeat'
      ELSE 'One-time'
    END AS giver_type
  FROM donor_counts
),
giver_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    giver_type,
    COUNT(*) AS giver_count,
    SUM(d."Amount") AS total_amount
  FROM "donations" d
  JOIN donor_categories dc ON d."Donor" = dc."Donor"
  GROUP BY giver_type
)
SELECT 
  (repeat_total_amount * 100.0 / NULLIF(one_time_total_amount + repeat_total_amount, 0)) AS repeat_share_percent,
  repeat_giver_count
FROM (
  SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN giver_type = 'Repeat' THEN giver_count ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_giver_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN giver_type = 'Repeat' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_total_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN giver_type = 'One-time' THEN giver_count ELSE 0 END) AS one_time_giver_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN giver_type = 'One-time' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS one_time_total_amount
  FROM giver_stats
) sub;
